description: This file declares types, functions, and constants related to processing miscellaneous information and Vbmeta arguments in the Cuttlefish project. It includes function prototypes for parsing, writing, and merging miscellaneous info, as well as obtaining Vbmeta arguments.

classes.name: VbmetaArgs
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for Vbmeta operations, including algorithm, key path, chained partitions, included partitions, and extra arguments.

methods.description: Generates combined dynamic partition information from vendor and system info, considering extracted images.
